description: This file implements backend APIs for the COSA Data Model Library related to reports, including creation, initialization, and removal of report objects. It references internal modules for network device status and traffic, and conditionally includes management server features.

methods.name: CosaReportsCreate
methods.description: Creates and allocates memory for a reports object, returning its handle.

methods.name: CosaReportsInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the reports object by setting up network device status, traffic, and optionally managed device features.

methods.name: CosaReportsRemove
methods.description: Frees the memory allocated for the reports object.
